libraryDecision.corrections: Local tested extensions fix sparse aggregates, missing common functions, blank/error distinction, TRIM behavior, dynamic array operators, date arithmetic, lexical LET/LAMBDA, and row visibility semantics.

Tokenizer and static AST, dependency graph and range dependencies without whole-column expansion
Dirty propagation and persistent worker incremental recalculation; structural fallback rebuild
Cross-sheet, quoted-sheet, range-name and named-expression references
Relative, absolute and mixed reference transforms including whole row/column copy and structural edits
Circular-reference detection and explicit error propagation; no eval or imported code execution
Manual/automatic modes, explicit recalculation, local volatile functions
Scalar/array operator broadcasting, dynamic spills, blocked spills and downstream spill dependencies
Nested lexical LET, immediately invoked and named LAMBDA, recursion bounds and lazy scalar IF
1900/1904 civil date arithmetic including historical serial 60
Number formatting independent of values, custom numeric SSF formatting and bounded date-format rendering
Typed validation with atomic user batches and protected-cell edits
Table column/current-row references, downward table auto-expansion and formula autofill with undo metadata
Distinct filtered/manually hidden rows in SUBTOTAL and reference AGGREGATE
Cell-delta undo/redo and structural workbook snapshots
Worker response revision isolation, formula autocomplete/signature help and reference-outline extraction
Dynamic elementwise text operations, regression-tested for UPPER/LOWER/LEFT/LEN/TRIM

notes: #CIRC! is a LopeOS diagnostic for circular references; it is not a claim of identical native Excel presentation.
SUM/AVERAGE/MIN/MAX/COUNT families use sparse traversal for whole-column ranges; functions requiring dense matrices reject oversized ranges with explicit errors.
Table auto-expansion only applies to contiguous edited rows immediately below a table, skips totals/protected tables and avoids overlapping tables or merges. Existing occupied cells are preserved.
Worksheet protection restricts editing; it is not encryption.
No local workbook data is sent to remote formula services.
The Microsoft catalog is current documentation; per-function introduction markers are evidence, not blanket availability claims for the pinned UI reference.
Union collections passed into local aggregate/numeric adapters produce explicit #VALUE! rather than fabricated zero. Use separate range arguments.
